answer_1.quote: We propose a LLM-based conversation summarizer. For each exemplar to be indexed and also each test dialog, the summarizer produces a text summarizing what the user wants at this point of the conversation.
answer_1.outputs: conversation summaries, retrieved exemplars, dialogue state predictions

answer_2.quote: we report average and standard deviation of Joint Goal Accuracy (JGA) and F1 score ) on all 7,368 test dialogues from MultiWOZ with three runs.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation of 135 summaries generated by the conversation summarizer, namely gpt-3.5-turbo. Specifically, three human judges are asked to assess whether the generated summaries are consistent with the instructions in the prompt.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges assess whether each generated summary is consistent with the prompt instructions.
